title: Round-robin scheduler timeline
prompt:
Simulate a round-robin CPU scheduler with a time slice of 3 and a switching cost of 1. The jobs, given as name, arrival time and total running time needed, are: A 0 5, B 1 3, C 3 8, D 11 2, E 30 4, F 30 1.
Rules:
- Jobs that wait to run are kept in one queue.
- Whenever the CPU becomes free at time t (at the start, or when a slice ends), first every job whose arrival time is t or earlier and that has not joined the queue yet joins the end of the queue (jobs arriving at the same time join in the order listed above); then, if the slice that just ended did not finish its job, that job joins the end of the queue; then the CPU takes the job at the front of the queue.
- The CPU runs the job it took for a slice of 3 time units, or less if the job needs less than 3 more units to finish.
- Before a slice, the CPU spends 1 time unit switching if the previous slice belonged to a different job and the CPU has not been idle since that previous slice. There is no switching for the very first slice, after an idle period, or when a job runs again right after its own slice. Jobs that arrive during the switching unit join the queue later, at the next time the CPU becomes free, like any other arrival.
- If the queue is empty when the CPU becomes free (after the arrivals have joined), the CPU is idle until the next arrival time, and then becomes free again at that time.
Print the timeline in time order, one line per period, as `START-END WHAT`, where WHAT is the job name for a slice, `switch` for a switching unit, or `idle` for an idle period (a whole idle period is one line). Two slices of the same job in a row are printed as two lines. Then print one line per job, in the order listed above: `NAME finish F wait W`, where F is the time its last slice ends and W is F minus its arrival time minus its running time.
expected_output:
0-3 A
3-4 switch
4-7 B
7-8 switch
8-11 C
11-12 switch
12-14 A
14-15 switch
15-17 D
17-18 switch
18-21 C
21-23 C
23-30 idle
30-33 E
33-34 switch
34-35 F
35-36 switch
36-37 E
A finish 14 wait 9
B finish 7 wait 3
C finish 23 wait 12
D finish 17 wait 4
E finish 37 wait 3
F finish 35 wait 4
